title: Bhagsu & Dharamkot Travel Guide | Things to Do, Nearby Attractions & Best Time to Visit
content:
Bhagsu & Dharamkot - Himachal Pradesh,

Bhagsu and Dharamkot are two Beautiful villages Situated in the serene hills of Himachal Pradesh, just a short distance from the famous McLeod Ganj. Bhagsu is well-known for the Bhagsunath Temple, an ancient Hindu shrine, and the Bhagsu Waterfall, a beautiful natural cascade surrounded by pine trees. The village has a laid-back vibe and is perfect for travelers who want to relax, enjoy nature, or explore small trekking trails. The winding lanes, friendly locals, and cozy cafes make Bhagsu feel warm and welcoming.

Dharamkot, perched slightly above McLeod Ganj, is quieter and more peaceful. It’s famous for yoga and meditation retreats, guesthouses with Himalayan views, and small walking trails through forests and tea plantations. Unlike the busier streets of McLeod Ganj, Dharamkot offers a slow-paced experience, ideal for travelers who want to enjoy the mountains, watch sunsets over the Dhauladhar range, or simply soak in the calm atmosphere.

Both villages are popular with backpackers, solo travelers, and families who enjoy nature, trekking, and local culture. Visitors can explore small streams, forest trails, local shops, and cafes serving Tibetan cuisine, including momos, thukpa, and butter tea. Bhagsu and Dharamkot are also good starting points for treks like Triund, which offer panoramic views of the mountains and valley.

Overall, Bhagsu and Dharamkot are perfect places to combine relaxation, adventure, and culture. Whether you want to visit temples, chase waterfalls, enjoy Himalayan views, practice yoga, or take short hikes, these villages offer a memorable mountain experience away from the crowds.

Location & Distance from Major Cities:

  • From Delhi: 520 km
  • From Chandigarh: 210 km
  • From Manali: 300 km
  • From Shimla: 220 km
  • From Amritsar: 200 km

Best Time to Visit Bhagsu & Dharamkot:

  • Peak Season (March – June / October – November):
    Ideal for sightseeing, trekking, and photography. Temperatures range from 15°C to 25°C. Clear skies and vibrant greenery make it perfect for travelers.
  • Moderate Season (July – September):
    Monsoon season brings lush greenery with temperatures 14°C to 22°C. Trails can be slippery, so trekking requires caution, but the scenery is fresh and peaceful.
  • Low Season (December – February):
    Winter is cold, sometimes dropping to 0°C – 12°C, with occasional snowfall at higher points. Perfect for travelers who enjoy a quiet, snowy Himalayan experience.

Things to Do Near  Bhagsu & Dharamkot :

  • Visit Bhagsunath Temple and explore its surroundings
  • Trek to Bhagsu Waterfall and enjoy nature
  • Relax or do yoga in Dharamkot retreats
  • Try local Tibetan cuisine at cafes
  • Walk along forest trails with scenic views
  • Capture Himalayan sunrise and sunset
  • Start trekking to Triund from either village

Top 5 Nearby Attractions (within 50 km):

1- McLeod Ganj – Tibetan culture, monasteries, markets (2–3 km),

2- Triund Trek – Beginner-friendly trek with panoramic Himalayan views (6 km),

3- St. John in the Wilderness Church – Historic colonial church in pine forests (2 km),

4- Naddi Village – Scenic village known for sunset viewpoints (4 km),

5- Namgyal Monastery – Spiritual center of Tibetan Buddhism (2 km),

faqs.question: How for from Bhagsu and Dharamkot from McLeod Ganj?
faqs.answer: Bhagsu is just 2 km and Dharamkot is 3 km from McLeod Ganj. You can easily walk or hire a local taxi.

faqs.question: Which place is better for beginner trekking?
faqs.answer: The Triund trek starting from either Bhagsu or Dharamkot is perfect for beginners. The trail is well-marked, and the Himalayan views along the way are breathtaking.

faqs.question: What is Bhagsu famous for?
faqs.answer: Bhagsunath Temple, Bhagsu Waterfall, and scenic forest trails.

faqs.question: What are the must-try local foods?
faqs.answer: Bhagsu and Dharamkot are known for Tibetan cuisine. Try momos, thukpa, butter tea, and freshly baked pastries at local cafes.

faqs.question: What makes Bhagsu famous among tourists?
faqs.answer: Bhagsu is popular for its ancient Bhagsunath Temple, the scenic Bhagsu Waterfall, and peaceful forest trails. It’s a must-visit for nature lovers and spiritual travelers.
